title: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is removed, so `osf review run` now fails a push on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run. To keep a broken reviewer from looping forever, a new round budget (`in_sandbox_rounds`, `could_not_run_rounds`, both default 3) is counted in the journal state directory, keyed by worktree, and lets a findings round through once past its limit while a could-not-run streak ends blocked with a message. A credential preflight decides a reviewer with no key and no login file before any worker starts, and the secret scrubber now also reads agent login files. The moon `review` task drops `--warn-only`, passes the work item, and the whole-run timeout default drops to 1800s.

nodes.label: review run / reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code, finish_review
nodes.summary: `--warn-only` is gone from both subcommands. `finish_review` now takes a `count_rounds` flag and the config root: it computes a base exit code from the verdict plus any kept must-fix/should-fix finding, and for `review run` consults the round budget before returning. `review reduce` passes `count_rounds = false`, so the pull-request path fails on a kept finding but never touches the budget.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new `[review]` fields with defaults of 3, rejected when zero. The whole-run timeout default drops from 2700 to 1800 seconds.

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundCounts, RoundKind
nodes.summary: The new budget. A pass clears the counts; a findings round increments and allows the push once past the limit; a could-not-run round increments and returns an error naming the limit once past its own. Counts are keyed by a hash of the canonical worktree path.

nodes.label: review_run::run
nodes.subtitle: setup, run_reviewer_unscrubbed
nodes.summary: The reviewer loop now calls a credential preflight before starting a worker, and a reviewer with no credential is recorded as could-not-run for every lens without spawning a process.

nodes.label: missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.summary: Decides whether a reviewer has any way to sign in: a non-empty credential variable, or at least one existing login path under the real home. A templated reviewer is never judged, since its template may carry its own auth.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: login_values, json_leaves
nodes.summary: The scrubber now also collects every string leaf of each agent's JSON login file, so a provider key kept in an auth file is redacted like an environment variable.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: untracked filter
nodes.summary: Untracked paths under `.osf/` are dropped from the changed-file set, so osf's own review output cannot change which lenses the next round selects.

nodes.label: journal state dir
nodes.subtitle: review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.summary: Where the round counts live, outside the worktree the builder can edit. A pass removes the file.

nodes.label: moon review task
nodes.subtitle: osf-pre-push, osf-slot-review
nodes.summary: Drops `--warn-only`, passes `--work-item .osf/out/work-item.txt`, and its comment now states that a kept finding or a could-not-run review fails the push. Still not tagged for the pull-request checkpoint.

nodes.label: osf.toml [review]
nodes.subtitle: concurrency 16, timeout 1800
nodes.summary: Pins the repository's own review settings and renames the opencode secret to `OSF_REVIEW_OPENCODE_API_KEY`.

nodes.label: CI review workflow
nodes.subtitle: base-branch review.yml
nodes.summary: The merge authority. Unchanged here, but the same kept-finding rule now applies to its reduce step.

edges.label: round_allows_push
edges.summary: The connection the change is about: the exit code of a pre-push review is now decided by the round budget, not by the verdict alone.
